meta.title: Confident Picks
meta.notice: Our picks come from our own models. Sportsbook lines captured Monday 9:50 AM ET are shown only for comparison.
meta.method: Every pick, projection and win chance comes from our models, built from game results, play-by-play and injury reports, with no betting lines as inputs. Each model was tested week by week on 2023-2025, retrained every week on games before that week. 'Books' shows the sportsbook line and the book's own chance for our side; Agree means the book favors the same side.
meta.timing: In 2024-2025 testing, our 60%+ props paid more when bet 1 to 6 hours before kickoff than a day or two early (best-book return +3% to +5% vs +1% in 2024; +11% to +12% vs +10% in 2025). Each 60%+ prop shows its window.

nhl_winners.vs_prices: At the closing price (2021-22 to 2025-26), winners rated 60%+ won 67.3% (dev) and 65.4% (held back), as stated, and returned -2.7% / -3.5% at the median US price (-0.8% / -1.8% at the best price): the grade says how often they win, not that they beat the price. Puck lines, totals and props lost money at every level of our chance, so they stay ungraded.

nba_winners.period: 2018-19 to 2025-26 (week by week; model settings chosen on 2009-10 to 2017-18)

nhl_grade_rules.tested: Week-by-week walk-forward, retrained weekly on games before that week. Winners rated 60%+: 2016-2024 won 65.8% of 3,109; held-back 2025-2026 won 65.3% of 853. Bands (held back): 60-64% won 61.6%, 65-69% won 68.7%, 70%+ won 74.5%. Below 60% is not graded (55-59% won 54.8% held back).
nhl_grade_rules.vs_prices: At the closing price (2021-22 to 2025-26), winners rated 60%+ won 67.3% (dev) and 65.4% (held back), as stated, and returned -2.7% / -3.5% at the median US price (-0.8% / -1.8% at the best price): the grade says how often they win, not that they beat the price. Puck lines, totals and props lost money at every level of our chance, so they stay ungraded.

nba_grade_rules.tested: Week-by-week walk-forward, retrained weekly on games before that week (basketball/nba_games.py). Winners rated 60%+: 2010-2018 won 75.1%; 2019-2026 won 71.6% of 6,269. Bands 2019-26: 60-64% won 62.7%, 65-69% won 66.9%, 70%+ won 79.0%.
nba_grade_rules.vs_prices: At prices 5 minutes before tip (2021-22 to 2025-26), winners rated 60%+ won 68.7% (2021-23) and 73.1% (2023-26), as stated, and returned -7.0% / -4.9% at the median US price (-4.4% / -3.2% at the best price): the grade says how often they win, not that they beat the price. Spreads and totals won 48-51% at the books' numbers, so they stay ungraded (research/nba_vs_books.py).

soc_grade_rules.tested: Week-by-week walk-forward (soccer/soccer_model.py), Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1 and MLS. Home or away wins rated 60%+: 2018-19 to 2021-22 won 70.0% (1,088 with closing prices); 2022-23 to 2026-27 won 72.3% (1,566). Bands (held back): 60-64% won 66.7%, 65-69% won 71.3%, 70%+ won 79.8%.
soc_grade_rules.vs_prices: At the books' average closing price, winners rated 60%+ returned -5.8% (2019-22) and -0.5% (2023-27); at the best closing price -2.1% / +2.8%. The grade says how often they win, not that they beat the price (research/soccer_vs_books.py). 90 minutes only.
soc_grade_rules.total_note: Not graded: over/under 2.5 picks rated 58%+ won 61-62% but lost 3-4% at the books' prices (research/soccer_vs_books.py)

cbb_grade_rules.tested: Week-by-week walk-forward (basketball/nba_games.py --league mbb), Division I games. 2019-2026: 72.0% of winners right; rated 60%+ won 77% of about 4,300 a season. Bands 2019-26: 60-69% won 63.9%, 70-79% won 74.1%, 80-89% won 84.3%, 90%+ won 94.9%.
cbb_grade_rules.vs_prices: At the 11 AM ET line (about when we post), winners rated 60%+ won 77.3% (2021-23, 7,186 games) and 77.0% (2023-26, 10,995), as stated, and returned -1.2% / -1.9% at the median US price (+0.7% / -0.5% at the best price). The grade says how often they win, not that they beat the price. Spreads and totals won 50% at the books' numbers, so they stay ungraded (research/cbb_vs_books.py).

ufc_grade_rules.tested: Month-by-month walk-forward, refit every month on earlier fights (ufc/ufc_model.py). 2019-2026: 61.3% of 3,894 fights; rated 60%+ won 68.9% of 1,943. Bands: 60-64% won 65.3%, 65-69% won 66.6%, 70%+ won 76.4%.
ufc_grade_rules.vs_prices: At fight-day prices (1 PM ET), UFC picks rated 60%+ won 67.9% (2021-23, 536 fights) and 71.6% (2024-26, 630), and returned +0.8% / +1.0% at the median US price (+3.0% / +3.2% at the best price) (research/ufc_vs_books.py). Thin edge on a modest sample; the live record decides whether it stays.
